profiles.turtlecute: Exact Turtlecute test inventory; includes dashboards, SDK assets and mixed-use services.
profiles.telemetry: Documented event and crash ingestion endpoints; shared endpoints affect multiple apps.
profiles.complete: Turtlecute inventory plus documented telemetry collectors. Includes all Turtlecute risks.
profiles.supplement-dns: Complete minus unconditional domain blocks found in AdGuard DNS filter; static candidate supplement.
profiles.supplement-browser: Complete minus domain-anchored blocks found in selected browser lists, including conditional blocks; candidates only.
profiles.aggressive: Complete plus mixed-use analytics and feature-flag services; may break app functionality.
profiles.turtlecute-upstream: Published Turtlecute hosts list; may include names absent from the live test.
